target.title: fix(agents): keep missing error details out of auth health
target.body:
Related: #100600

AI-assisted: yes. I understand the touched auth-profile failure policy: the change keeps the existing `no_error_details` failover diagnostic available for retry/fallback decisions, avoids persisting detail-less non-OpenAI provider failures as shared auth-profile health, and preserves the existing OpenAI WHAM-backed handling for `no_error_details`.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users with valid Azure/OpenAI-compatible credentials could have an active auth profile cooled down when an upstream `response.failed` event omitted error details. That detail-less provider failure can then look like a credential/auth problem and contribute to misleading fallback or auth-profile health state.

## Why This Change Was Made

`no_error_details` is a runtime/transport diagnostic, not proof that a non-OpenAI shared auth profile is bad. This change treats it like other non-credential transport failures for non-OpenAI providers while preserving the pre-existing OpenAI path where `markAuthProfileFailure` can probe WHAM for OAuth/subscription/account-limit states.

The change is intentionally narrow: it does not change `auth`, `billing`, `rate_limit`, timeout-after-provider-start, model fallback, or the Responses `response.failed` observation path. The embedded runner now resolves the failing provider from the failing auth profile before applying the policy, so auth-profile rotation does not accidentally classify the failure using a later fallback provider.

## User Impact

Valid Azure/OpenAI-compatible credentials are less likely to enter cooldown solely because a provider returned a failed response without useful error fields. Existing OpenAI WHAM-backed health handling for `no_error_details` remains available.

## Evidence

- Provider-specific policy proof: `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.test.ts` now verifies `no_error_details` returns `null` for a non-OpenAI provider (`azure-foundry`) and still returns `no_error_details` for normalized `OpenAI`, preserving the WHAM path in `src/agents/auth-profiles/usage.ts`.
- Runtime harness proof: `src/agents/model-fallback.run-embedded.e2e.test.ts` now drives a detail-less `azure-foundry/mock-1` primary failure through `runWithModelFallback` + `runEmbeddedAgent`, verifies fallback to `groq/mock-2`, records `result.attempts[0]?.reason === "no_error_details"`, verifies `azure-foundry:p1` keeps both `cooldownUntil` and `failureCounts.no_error_details` unset, verifies `groq:p1` records `lastUsed`, and verifies no `openai` attempt occurred.
- This uses deterministic mocked provider attempts only; no live credentials, request IDs, account IDs, or private endpoints are included.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.test.ts` passed: 1 file, 9 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.e2e.config.ts src/agents/model-fallback.run-embedded.e2e.test.ts -t "missing provider error details"` passed: 1 file, 1 test, 20 skipped.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.e2e.config.ts src/agents/model-fallback.run-embedded.e2e.test.ts` passed: 1 file, 21 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/auth-profiles/usage.test.ts src/agents/auth-profiles.markauthprofilefailure.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.test.ts` passed: 3 files, 97 tests.
- Earlier validation on this PR also passed: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.e2e.config.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner.e2e.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner.run-embedded-agent.auth-profile-rotation.e2e.test.ts` (2 files, 46 tests) and the broader related unit shard (6 files, 438 tests).
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.test.ts src/agents/model-fallback.run-embedded.e2e.test.ts` passed.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.test.ts src/agents/model-fallback.run-embedded.e2e.test.ts` passed.
